participant_id.description: Participant record ID. Pass this as `last_participant_id` to retrieve the next page.

user_name.description: Participant's username. Absent if the account is hidden or not found.

title.description: Link text for the user page

classes.description: CSS classes for the user page link, as generated by core

user_page.description: Link data for the participant's user page. Absent if the account is hidden or not found.

user_registered_at_formatted.description: Registration timestamp formatted for display according to the preferences of the user making the request

hidden.description: Present and true if the user account is suppressed

not_found.description: Present and true if the user account does not exist

user_is_valid_recipient.description: Whether the user can receive email from the user making the request. Only present for organizers with email permissions.

non_pii_answers.description: Non-personally-identifiable answers to participant questions. Only present for ongoing events when the requester has the required permissions. A string if the answers have already been aggregated; otherwise an array of answer objects.

message.description: Human-readable answer, or a placeholder if no response was given

questionID.description: ID of the question, matching the Get available participant questions endpoint

oneOf.description: Explanation of why the answers have already been aggregated
